verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs state it captures every session, trace, and span, and its SDK `@log` decorator logs spans. Spans sharing a trace ID are joined into one trace, and multi-agent LangGraph tutorials cover session-level views. Together this documents a session → trace → span hierarchy for multi-step agent runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of parent-child span nesting depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of the session/thread grouping UI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Once instrumented, Galileo captures every session, trace, and span, producing a structured stream of real-time data.
You can also use the `@log` decorator to log spans.
Galileo joins all spans that share a trace ID into a single trace.
Add Galileo evaluations to a multi-agent LangGraph app; View and understand session level metrics
Learn how to instrument a LangGraph agent with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture detailed traces, spans, and metrics.
